# RocketList Startup Jobs

RocketList publishes a daily, sanitized dataset of active startup jobs and companies.

Homepage: https://rocketlist.ai
Repository: https://github.com/rocketlist-ai/startup-jobs
Latest release: https://github.com/rocketlist-ai/startup-jobs/releases/latest
Jobs Parquet: https://github.com/rocketlist-ai/startup-jobs/releases/latest/download/jobs.parquet
Companies Parquet: https://github.com/rocketlist-ai/startup-jobs/releases/latest/download/companies.parquet
Job schema: https://github.com/rocketlist-ai/startup-jobs/blob/main/schema/jobs.schema.json
Company schema: https://github.com/rocketlist-ai/startup-jobs/blob/main/schema/companies.schema.json
Live MCP: https://rocketlist.ai/mcp

Use canonical job URLs from the dataset when directing someone to apply. Treat missing values as unknown; do not infer compensation, eligibility, seniority, or remote availability. The source application page is authoritative because roles can close between daily snapshots.
